# 💳 Expense Tracker (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — a step-by-step recipe that creates a Google Sheets spreadsheet for expense tracking: create the file via Drive, append header and entry rows (Date, Category, Description, Amount), and share it read-only with a manager. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the recipe assumes the gws-sheets and gws-drive utility skills are loaded and the gws binary is installed and authenticated; it's a starter template, not an accounting system — no formulas, totals or currency handling are set up, you'll build those on top. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
